purpose: Add opt-in admission control and per-request reranker timing telemetry without changing the certified ranking algorithm or Phase 3G canary behavior.

admission_control.timeout_derivation: Phase 3F added-latency budget is 500 ms and Phase 3G warm added p95 was 275.988 ms; residual 224.012 ms is rounded down to 200 ms.
admission_control.timeout_behavior: fail open to the certified first-stage hybrid ranking and report reranker degradation only

live_gate.p95_derivation: Rounded below half of the Phase 3G observed reranker concurrent p95 of 2083.837 ms.

decision_rule: Pass only if the historical Phase 3G gates remain unchanged and green, the opt-in Phase 3H canary bounds admission wait, preserves hybrid fallback ranking on saturation, exposes timing telemetry, recovers after the burst, and stays below the preregistered concurrent API p95 limit.
